method: Original xcresult attachments and CoreAudio log archive. Render/coreaudiod association uses raw mach host ticks, not Date-to-log UTC conversion. The probe Date anchor and log wall timestamps differ by about 157 ms in this run; a narrow Date sampling interval is not a bound on that cross-source wall-clock difference.
limits: TimePitch pre/post elapsed includes preemption and excludes other HAL graph work; audio host stamps are not deadlines. Native timeline skip intersection exactly predicts three observed PCM losses for these uninterrupted rate-1 fixtures, but does not identify the hypervisor/device/scheduler root cause.
